title: Preliminary limit conditions
statement: Let the word limit be an integer and the space limit, depth limit, and parameters $M_o,V,f_r$ be natural numbers. The limits and parameters satisfy the preliminary conditions if $1\le M_o$, the space limit is at most the word limit, $4V+4M_o+16$ is at most the word limit, and $f_r+\lfloor\log_2(V+1)\rfloor+2$ is at most the space limit.
hypotheses_covered: space limit is at most word limit
